mods.html: At Builds by Carly, we don’t just build tiny homes — we build long-term investments. Every home is site-built in the Smoky Mountains with a sharp focus on architectural beauty, guest appeal, and real-world performance. Backed by a dedicated team, our homes are designed to thrive on the short-term rental market while offering timeless quality and style.

These are site-built tiny homes—not sheds, park models, or mobile units. Built on permanent foundations with licensed trades and code-aligned construction, our homes are designed to appraise like traditional builds, unlock better financing paths, and hold long-term value.

What that means for you: durability, credibility, and a true asset—built to perform.

We build on block and elevated pier foundations, including our signature treehouse-style pier system for steep or rocky terrain. It’s engineered for stability while creating the elevated views and “wow factor” that drives clicks, bookings, and higher nightly rates.

Investor win: better sites become buildable—and more marketable.

Don’t already have land? We can help you identify and acquire the right property for your build and your rental goals. You approve the final selection—we guide you toward lots that fit your budget, access, slope, utilities, and the guest experience you want to sell.

From wooded privacy to panoramic views, we match the setting to the strategy.

We build on block and elevated pier foundations, including our signature treehouse-style pier system for steep or rocky terrain. It’s engineered for stability while creating the elevated views and “wow factor” that drives clicks, bookings, and higher nightly rates.

Builds by Carly is more than a name — it’s a team of professionals dedicated to crafting investment properties that merge beauty, quality, and performance. What began as a single land developer's vision has evolved into a trusted brand in the Smoky Mountains, known for site-built tiny homes that deliver big returns.
Our team understands what modern investors are looking for: properties that are visually striking, guest-ready, and built to last. From foundational engineering to design-forward finishes, we’ve thought through every square foot — because luxury lives in the details.
Founded by Carly Bowlen, a land developer with deep roots in Sevier County and a passion for innovation in the short-term rental market, Builds by Carly continues to set the standard for tiny homes with outsized impact.
Whether you're investing in your first property or expanding your portfolio, our site-built tiny homes offer an elevated entry point into the world of real estate — without compromising on comfort, craftsmanship, or return on investment.

Todd Parker

"We are the proud owners of the Flame Azalea treehouse. We have been building in the mountains for years now and have several cabins. Working with Carly has been the best experience out of all the builds we have done. We would highly recommend her and her team for your project."

Ryan Cushman

"Carly is so great to work with… so much so that a part of me did not want to write this review because that part of me doesn’t want other people to know about her… :). We are the proud owners of Frame Worthy. A perfect stilted A-frame that was masterfully built with beautiful craftsmanship. We plan to keep building future tiny homes with Carly. Can’t say enough good things about working with Carly!! 10 stars."

Connor Cushman

"I can’t speak highly enough of Carly and the quality of her work. I’ve worked with many different builders and contractors throughout the southeast and Carly is in a league of her own. Her attention to detail, quality of communication, and professionalism is unmatched. You will not regret working with Carly. We are currently on our 3rd build with her!"

We've partnered with a trusted local lender to provide financing tailored to your tiny home investment. Whether it’s your first property or your fifth, we’ll help make the process simple, clear, and successful.
From land selection to turnkey delivery, our team is here to help you create a luxury tiny home that performs — and pays off.

The Juniper is named after Juniperus virginiana, the native red cedar found throughout the Great Smoky Mountains. This 384 sq ft, 1 bed, 1 bath home is a cozy mountain retreat with a 16’ x 24’ footprint.
 
Thoughtfully designed for comfort and charm, it’s perfect for short-term stays or personal getaways.
 
An 8’ x 24’ outdoor deck and 8’ x 6’ roofed entrance provide 240 sq ft of additional outdoor living.

Photos shown feature the block foundation, but every model can also be built in our elevated “treehouse” style if your land calls for it — or your heart just wants it. We’ll help you choose the best fit based on your property and goals.

Whether you're building a vacation rental or a personal retreat, the Juniper model offers flexibility, comfort, and style. Buyers can personalize a wide range of finishes—including flooring, paint colors, cabinetry, lighting, hardware, and exterior siding—to match their vision. Want to add a larger deck, built-in shelves, or other custom touches? We're happy to help bring those ideas to life.

The Juniper model includes full residential systems installed by licensed professionals and built to code. A ductless mini split provides energy-efficient heating and cooling, while the electric fireplace adds ambiance. Standard residential electrical systems are included, plus a 220V line to power a hot tub on the deck. Water and sewer connections depend on the location—public utility or private well/septic. Insulation is up to code for year-round efficiency.

Each Juniper model can be built on either a block foundation or our treehouse-style elevated pier foundation. While some buyers choose based on style or budget, others may need elevation for steeper terrain. Both options are structurally sound, built to code, and chosen based on your land’s slope and soil. We'll help you choose the best foundation to suit your needs while ensuring long-term durability.

No need to bring your own lot—the land is included in the purchase price. We handle the land search and purchase, presenting you with only carefully vetted properties that meet your goals. You'll have full approval over the final selection before we begin building. From Smoky Mountain views to wooded privacy, we’ll help you choose the best possible setting for your home.

The Juniper brings the timeless charm of a Smoky Mountain cabin into a refined, small-footprint design. Its clean lines, cozy proportions, and warm finishes reflect the rustic feel of a traditional cabin, while upgraded materials and attention to detail elevate it beyond the ordinary. Whether you're styling it with vintage touches or a modern rustic palette, the Juniper’s architecture is designed to blend seamlessly with natural surroundings—delivering comfort, character, and curb appeal in a home that’s as inviting as it is investment-ready.

While the Juniper leans into classic cabin style, it offers a fresh, updated take that blends mountain tradition with modern living. You’ll find nods to traditional design in its roofline, porch, and material palette—but with a cleaner, more contemporary edge that avoids heavy log cabin clichés. This fusion of styles makes the Juniper ideal for those who want the nostalgic coziness of a cabin with the lighter finishes and smarter layouts today’s buyers love. It’s the best of both worlds—elevated, but never overdone.

The Lily model was named after the speckled wood-lily (Clintonia umbellulata), native to the Great Smoky Mountains. This 1 bed, 1 bath A-frame includes 330 sq ft of living space with a 16’6” x 20’ footprint.
 
Its bright, open layout makes the most of every inch—ideal for cozy escapes and mountain getaways.
 
Outdoor living features a covered 8’ x 16’6” rear deck and 4’ x 16’6” front porch, totaling 198 sq ft.

No need to bring your own lot—the land is included in the purchase price. We handle the land search and purchase, presenting you with only carefully vetted properties that meet your goals. Unlike most tiny homes of its size, the Lily is a true A-frame—an architectural feat that’s rarely achieved on a 330-square-foot footprint. Its sharply pitched roofline and clean, geometric design make it both iconic and efficient. With soaring ceilings and natural light pouring through the window wall, the Lily offers the dramatic charm of a full-size A-frame while preserving the scale and functionality needed for a small-footprint build.

The Lily’s bathroom door can be built as either a pocket door or a barn-style sliding door—both perfect for small-space living. These options eliminate the need for door swing clearance, giving you more usable room in the living area and bathroom alike. Whether you prefer the modern simplicity of a pocket door or the rustic charm of a barn door, this thoughtful detail makes everyday movement more efficient and stylish.

INVESTMENT OPPORTUNITIES

Unlock a prime investment opportunity with Builds by Carly in one of the top vacation destinations in the nation, the Great Smoky Mountains in beautiful East Tennessee. Real-time data continues to reveal exceptional revenue opportunities for 1-bedroom properties in this area making tiny homes a profitable and appealing option for first-time AND veteran investors.

Our meticulously crafted homes are paired with carefully selected land and backed by proven metrics. We invite you to redefine your investment goals and connect with us as your trusted resource. Read on for more valuable information!

WHY
TINY HOMES

Tiny homes and their enticing return on investment potential have piqued global interest with a wave of popularity surrounding their niche appeal and compact size and affordability.

These fully functional living spaces are typically approximately 500 square feet but have all the modern conveniences desirable to renters and owners alike. These popular abodes are filled with tons of positive appeal with one key element being the simplicity of maintaining them. With their smaller footprint, there are fewer repairs to be concerned with and maintenance requirements are minimal for an investor or owner.

For investors, the Great Smoky Mountains and surrounding areas offer an optimal opportunity to tap into the popularity and appeal of renting a tiny home for a calming mountain getaway. As a relatively new and niche concept, tiny homes continue to draw the interest of people more interested in a cozy experience versus vacationing in the typical oversized cabins which usually cost more money while keeping them apart.  

Despite their smaller size, tiny homes offer the same comforts and functionality as traditional homes, with an emphasis on efficient use of space. Not only are homes with smaller square footage more financially efficient for heating/cooling costs, but they also require less energy and gas to operate. In fact, each feature in a tiny home real estate project is meticulously considered for an exceptional outcome for both the user and the investor.  

You can expect the same and more when partnering with Builds by Carly. Every single detail has been carefully thought out and every square inch has been optimized so that you as an investor can reap the benefits without the hassle of planning, navigating, or overseeing a new build on your own. We are your local, tiny home expert and guide!

Park + attractions + repeat trips create year-round demand in Sevier County. Great Smoky Mountains National Park pulls visitors in every season, while Dollywood and the entertainment corridors keep “non-park days” active—even when the weather doesn’t cooperate. Most trips are short breaks from drive-in metros, which concentrates bookings on weekends and holidays and supports strong ADR for photogenic tiny homes. The mix is resilient: shoulder months still book with the right pricing, visuals, and amenities.
The most-visited national park fuels steady traffic with hiking, scenic drives, and four-season views. Morning trail days + evening shows keep nights in-market—and calendars full.
Theme parks, shows, and dining corridors turn “what do we do today?” into reliable spend and bookings. Events and holidays stretch demand beyond peak months.
Short-break heavy (3–4 nights) with lots of repeat visitors. Guests respond to clean design, hot tubs, and Instagram-ready interiors — and easy, self-serve check-in.

About Builds by Carly
Site-Built Tiny Homes in Sevier County, TN — Serving Gatlinburg, Pigeon Forge & Beyond

BUILT
IN THE SMOKIES

Builds by Carly is a design-forward construction company based in Sevier County, Tennessee, building custom, site-built tiny homes across the Smoky Mountains. Our homes are crafted to perform as short-term rentals, with thoughtful designs that fit naturally into East Tennessee’s mountain terrain — whether you’re building near Gatlinburg, Pigeon Forge, Wears Valley, or deeper in the woods.
Every home is site-built — not shipped or prefab — and carefully matched to the land and rental market. From foundation to finish, our team brings a hands-on approach to mountain living and investment performance.

WHO
WE ARE

I’m Carly — a land developer, designer, and builder with a deep connection to the Smokies. Long before this became a company, I was buying land, building cabins, and learning what works (and what doesn’t) in short-term rentals across Sevier County.
Now, I lead a team that shares my commitment to detail and local knowledge. I’m personally involved in every build — from choosing the lot to final walkthrough. We don’t outsource big decisions or push cookie-cutter plans. You’ll see my footprint (literally) on-site throughout the process.

WHAT
MAKES US DIFFERENT

Most “tiny home builders” in the Smokies sell kits or prefabs. We don’t. At Builds by Carly, every home is built on-site with local crews who understand zoning, weather, views, and code. These are real homes — with real residential systems — designed to look beautiful and last in the mountain environment.
We offer two foundation types: traditional block or our signature elevated treehouse-style piers, ideal for wooded lots and steep terrain. The treehouse foundation is one of our most popular options and a key visual feature that sets our builds apart.
